title: Worktree
description: Per-task worktree record. Tracks filesystem location, branch, DB isolation, cache linkage, and lifecycle. Per Constitution Article 27.

id.description: Typically WT-<task-id> for agent worktrees; WT-_inventory, WT-_softgate, WT-_review-<task-id> for harness worktrees.

task_id.description: Null for permanent harness worktrees (inventory, soft-gate evaluator).

db_isolation.description: none for worktrees that don't need a DB (e.g., docs-only Architect tasks).

db_name.description: For database isolation: name of the TEMPLATE-cloned DB (e.g., devai_task_0123).

db_port.description: For cluster isolation: port of the dedicated container.

db_container_name.description: For cluster isolation: Docker container name.

cache_links.description: Symlinked cache directories from the integration HEAD checkout.

lockfile_hash.description: SHA-256 of package-lock.json at worktree creation. If different from integration HEAD, cache links are skipped.

counts_against_cap.description: False for harness-owned and human-adopted worktrees (Article 27 cap applies only to active agent worktrees).
